designNotes: Qi Condensation is the first-life school.
Use progressive disclosure instead of front-loaded tutorial walls.
Every unlock must answer a current player question.
Source before sink, sink before scale.
Tutorial cards teach and replay; gameplay events complete milestones.

milestones.label: Choose the shape of this life

objective.title: Choose the shape of this life
objective.why: A life needs a Path and Heart Law before the climb begins.
objective.optionalTip: Pick one doctrine now; you will learn the city after you learn to cultivate.

tutorialCard.title: Choose the shape of this life
tutorialCard.body: Your Path and Heart Law define this life. The city can wait until the first breath is steady.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: This is the only unavoidable setup step. Later guidance should be contextual and replayable.

milestones.label: Gather your first Qi

objective.title: Gather your first Qi
objective.why: Qi fills while you cultivate. Your first breakthrough teaches the shape of the realm ladder.
objective.rewardPreview: Status unlocks after your first breakthrough.
objective.optionalTip: For the first beat, there is no economy and no world map. Learn Qi first.

tutorialCard.title: The first breath gathers
tutorialCard.body: Qi gathers while you cultivate. When the bar fills, you can attempt your first breakthrough.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: The rest of the city opens later. The first loop is deliberately quiet.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Qi comes from cultivation and is spent on breakthrough.

milestones.label: Read your status

objective.title: Read your status
objective.why: Status shows what this life is and what is holding it back.
objective.rewardPreview: The World will open once you understand the current life.
objective.optionalTip: Status is safe to unlock first because it gives diagnosis without creating a resource or sink mismatch.

tutorialCard.title: Know the shape of this life
tutorialCard.body: Status shows your path, root, current strength, and next pressure. Use it when you are unsure what to improve.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: Read the run before the city starts offering resources. Diagnosis comes before economy.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Status creates no resource; it teaches diagnosis before economy.

milestones.label: Walk the Outskirts

objective.title: Walk the Outskirts
objective.why: Outskirts gives gold and common materials. You will use them soon.
objective.rewardPreview: Gold will soon become manuals in the Pavilion.
objective.optionalTip: Outskirts is the safe field route: gold, common materials, and low-risk combat reps.

tutorialCard.title: The forest path opens
tutorialCard.body: Outskirts gives gold, common materials, and low-risk combat reps. It is your first field loop.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: The Pavilion is already visible as a sealed destination so gold has a near-term purpose.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Gold and common materials come from Outskirts; gold soon becomes manuals and common materials later support Forge.

milestones.label: Buy your first manual

objective.title: Buy your first manual
objective.why: Gold becomes knowledge in the Pavilion.
objective.optionalTip: Manuals are teachings. They are not combat behavior until studied and equipped later.

tutorialCard.title: Gold becomes knowledge
tutorialCard.body: Manuals are teachings. Buy one, study it, and it will become a technique you can use in combat.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: If you cannot afford the first manual, the correct route is back to Outskirts.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Manual Pavilion is the first gold sink; it should never open into a dead unaffordable state in later UI packets.

milestones.label: Equip your first technique

objective.title: Equip your first technique
objective.why: Studied knowledge only affects combat after it enters your loadout.
objective.rewardPreview: Your build can now express learned doctrine in combat.
objective.optionalTip: If there is no eligible technique, finish studying a manual first.

tutorialCard.title: Knowledge becomes form
tutorialCard.body: Equip techniques into your loadout so your AI can express your build in combat.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: This milestone should teach only equip, basic slots, and AI profile. Advanced mastery can wait.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Manual study creates technique knowledge; the Techniques tab is the sink where knowledge becomes combat behavior.

milestones.label: Stock your medicine pouch

objective.title: Stock your medicine pouch
objective.why: Preparation keeps you alive when raw cultivation is not enough.
objective.rewardPreview: Medicine can now support harder fights automatically.
objective.optionalTip: Expeditions bring herbs while you cultivate, fight, or study. Apothecary turns them into survival.

tutorialCard.title: Prepare before the wound
tutorialCard.body: Medicine can be stocked in your pouch and used automatically in combat.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: Source and sink unlock together: Herb Route supplies, Apothecary prepares, Pouch uses.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Expeditions supply herbs; Apothecary and Medicine Pouch consume them as survival prep.

milestones.label: Raise your weapon floor

objective.title: Raise your weapon floor
objective.why: The gate cares about lasting power, not one lucky fight.
objective.rewardPreview: Your combat floor becomes more stable.
objective.optionalTip: If materials are missing, the later UI must name the best source rather than leaving a disabled button.

tutorialCard.title: Make strength hold its shape
tutorialCard.body: Forge raises your combat floor through gear. Gates will care about that floor.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: The first forge action should be simple and affordable from common materials.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Common materials and gold become gear and refinement, establishing a minimum combat floor.

milestones.label: Gather targeted support

objective.title: Gather targeted support
objective.why: Ruins and Bounties solve shortages before the gate.
objective.rewardPreview: Gate Trial becomes visible once the support loop is understood.
objective.optionalTip: Ruins target specific materials. Bounties point toward useful work and pay Merit.

tutorialCard.title: The city starts guiding you
tutorialCard.body: Ruins target specific materials. Bounties point you toward useful work and pay Merit, which supports gate safety nets.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: Multiple activities now exist, so the city needs a routing layer.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Ruins provide targeted support; Bounties provide direction and Merit for safety-net support.

milestones.label: Attempt the Foundation Gate

objective.title: Attempt the Foundation Gate
objective.why: The gate tests the whole loop you have learned.
objective.rewardPreview: The gate proof returns you to Cultivation for Foundation breakthrough.
objective.optionalTip: This is not a farm. If you fail, the gate should tell you what to fix next.

tutorialCard.title: The Foundation Gate awaits
tutorialCard.body: The gate checks whether your whole life is ready: Qi, build, medicine, gear, and support.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: Clearing or bypassing the gate supplies the breakthrough handoff. The breakthrough itself remains in Cultivation.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Gate Trial consumes readiness from every prior system and rewards the breakthrough catalyst or proof through existing gate systems.

milestones.label: Establish Foundation

objective.title: Establish Foundation
objective.why: Return to Cultivation to transform the gate proof into a new realm.
objective.rewardPreview: Core onboarding complete. Future help becomes contextual.
objective.optionalTip: You now know the city loop: cultivate, read, gather, study, prepare, craft, rotate, and challenge the gate.

tutorialCard.title: Foundation established
tutorialCard.body: You have learned the first city loop. Future help will appear when the next milestone needs it.
tutorialCard.moreDetail: Foundation is graduation from core onboarding, not another heavy tutorial.

milestones.sourceSinkNote: Core onboarding complete; normal contextual guidance continues.
